rv.q: If the production is uneven, well, so is the play.
This version only runs through August 23, so get your free tickets while you can.
Director Daniel Sullivan’s production, however, is done with enough intelligence and conviction to make a strong case for it as one of the Bard’s masterpieces.

There’s an understandable tendency for directors to reimagine works by William Shakespeare, to make them “relevant” to modern life and politics. But there’s also nothing wrong with a solid classic production focusing on the original script and featuring baggy Elizabethan costumes.

Theater Though Lily Rabe rivets, 'The Winter's Tale' overstays its welcome (Off Broadway review) Date: August 11, 2026. Author: There's a lot to admire in Daniel Sullivan's spirited new production of William Shakespeare's The Winter's Tale , now playing at the Public Theater's Delacorte Theater in Central Park.

cn.t: This Shakespeare in the Park production elevates a lesser-known work through strong performances from Esparza and Rabe, though the unwieldy narrative proves challenging despite skilled direction.
